The '''defense''' of the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Corvette/Legends|corvette]] ''[[Karinne]]'' occurred above [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] early in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Prelude==
At an early point<ref name="Date" /> in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] delegation left their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]],<ref name="Xwing" /> [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]],<ref name="Twiloth" /> aboard the [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] ''[[Karinne]]'', bound for a secret summit with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Alliance High Command/Legends|High Command]]. Learning of the negotiations from their [[Spy/Legends|spies]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] dispatched a small force consisting of the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Imperial Star Destroyer]] [[Avenger/Legends|''Avenger'']] and its [[TIE series/Legends|TIE]] complement to ambush the neutral [[Corvette/Legends|corvette]]. Discovering the impending ambush, [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance]] [[Counter-Intelligence]] was able to send only a pair of [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing starfighters]] from [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red Squadron]] to the Twi'leks' aid in an ambush of their own.<ref name="Xwing" />

==The battle==
The [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] entered the [[Ryloth system/Legends|system]] from [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], staying long enough only to release three [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa bombers]] each from [[Alpha Squadron|Alpha]], [[Beta Squadron/Legends|Beta]], and [[Gamma Squadron/Legends|Gamma Squadrons]] before departing.<ref name="Xwing" />

Taking the [[TIE pilot]]s by surprise with an assault from behind, the [[Rebel pilot/Legends|Rebel pilots]] used their [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedoes]] to stop the Imperial attack, allowing the ''Karinne'' to escape.<ref name="Xwing" />

==Aftermath==
Grateful for their rescue, the Twi'lek delegation soon agreed to join the Rebel Alliance.<ref name="Xwing" />

The engagement was later simulated as a training mission by the Rebel Alliance, intended to teach prospective Y-wing [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] to use their proton torpedoes to protect allied ships from TIE bombers. [[Agamarian]] Rebel [[Keyan Farlander/Legends|Keyan Farlander]] was assigned to the simulation by [[Training officer/Legends|training officer]] [[Wex Dafid]] prior to Farlander's recruitment into the Alliance [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] [[Independence/Legends|''Independence'']]{{'s}} Red Squadron.<ref name="XWOSG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle first appeared in the [[1993]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: X-Wing (video game)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'']] as the third Y-wing historical mission, "S.O.S. from Corvette Karinne."<ref name="Xwing" />

While ''X-Wing'' identifies the Twi'lek homeworld and site of the engagement as "Twi'lek,"<ref name="Xwing" /> it is more commonly known as Ryloth.<ref name="Ryloth">{{SWE|locations|ryloth|Ryloth}}</ref>
